current_behaviour: Every canonical building StaticMesh declares two FBX material slots with no bound material interface. No MAT_N_M, no /Game/Carla material and no fallback material asset is referenced by any sampled mesh or by any of the 20 tile worlds. Buildings therefore render with engine/default surface material behaviour.
why_not_blocking_cook: Cooking a StaticMesh with unbound material interfaces succeeds; the engine substitutes a default at render time. This is a visual and semantic fidelity issue, not a cook-process failure mode.
likely_semantic_impact: CARLA semantic segmentation is carried by materials. With no material bound, buildings are very likely to be untagged or default-tagged in the semantic camera. This was NOT verified by launching the runtime in this batch and must not be assumed either way.
correct_terminology_note: Current material state must NOT be described as visually correct.
